hub.description: The "All notes" window: listing, creating, opening, deleting and restoring notes, the trash, the settings (language, theme, start with the system, color of new notes), the tray texts, showing itself once loaded, listening to the backend's change events. No note content is written from here and no core:window permission is granted.

note.description: A note window (label note-<id>): reading and writing its own note, its color and keep on top, deleting and closing itself (the backend refuses any other note's ID), answering the backend's save requests before a delete from "All notes" or quitting, creating a new note, opening "All notes", reading the settings, the tray texts, showing itself once loaded, moving the frameless window by its header (start dragging) and listening to the backend's events.
